stages.name: main
stages.prompt: The program `bench_target.exe` (process id {pid}) simulates a game with one player who has a health value. Find the memory address of the player's current health value (a 32-bit integer). Several other values in the program hold the same number or something derived from it, so make sure the address you give is the health itself and not a copy. You may use bench_trigger to damage or heal the player. Do not change anything in the program. Submit the address as a hexadecimal string and the value you read there.

health_address.description: hexadecimal address of the player's health

health_value.description: the value read at that address when you finished
